title: Systematic discovery of enzyme promiscuity in Escherichia coli using in vitro metabolomics
task: Discover enzyme promiscuity via in vitro metabolomics screening
key_results: 11% of 667 E. coli enzymes exhibited unexpected promiscuous activities; 22 complete reaction stoichiometries reconstructed from 11 enzymes with 4 validated experimentally
comments: The 33% FDR threshold is permissive for discovery but raises questions about false positive rates in subsequent mechanistic studies.
